data.case_title: Private invoice from Ergotherapie Beispielhand for daughter's treatment
data.title: Invoice €430.00 from Ergotherapie Beispielhand
data.summary: Ergotherapie Beispielhand billed Johanna Beispielacker €430.00 as a private service (umsatzsteuerfrei) for her daughter's occupational therapy treatments between September and November 2026, payable within 21 days of the invoice date (18 November 2026). The letter also mentions a separate contract (HM-5583-367) with an automatic direct debit on 14 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is a private bill for occupational therapy sessions your daughter received, not covered by statutory health insurance (billed under §4 Nr. 14 UStG, VAT-exempt). You need to transfer €430.00 to the practice's account by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the invoice date. Keep this invoice, as medical treatment costs can sometimes be claimed as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) on your tax return. The letter also references an unrelated contract (HM-5583-367) with an automatic direct debit on 14 December 2026 for an unchanged amount — double-check with the sender what this contract is, since mixing it into a therapy invoice is unusual.
